title: Implement GET /api/batches and GET /api/batches/[id] routes
description: Create the API routes for listing all batches and fetching a single batch by ID.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/batches returns array of all batches
Both routes return properly structured JSON

steps.details: Export async GET handler. Call `listBatches()` from repository. Return NextResponse.json(batches).
Export async GET handler. Extract id from params. Call `getBatch(id)`. If null, return 404. Otherwise return the batch.
Run GET /api/batches (expect array). Run GET /api/batches/nonexistent (expect 404). Run GET /api/batches/[valid-id] (expect single batch).
